headline: Findlay draws with Lincoln to end winning run
dek: Findlay's draw with Lincoln halted its winning run since losing at Northwood, while lifting the program to 42 goals on the season, more than any other side in the conference. Lake Erie remains top of the table, while Findlay holds the sharpest attack in the league.
